post.description: Use the link sent to the new address (no session needed). The old address is told.
Revoke the current session and clear its cookie.
Send a sign-in link. Same answer whether the address has an account or not.
Exchange the link's token for a session (cookie `__Host-trv_session`).

get.description: Sign-in methods to show; the screens hide the others (no dead buttons).
Back from the provider (Google): query string `code` and `state`.

post.description: Back from Apple by a cross-site POST: park the answer, continue with a same-site GET.

get.description: Second half of the form_post return: the `Lax` cookie is sent on this same-site GET.
Redirect to the provider's consent page.

post.description: Staff enrolment (ADR-0018): creation options for the account of the link.

Registers the staff account's first passkey (single-use link) and opens an admin
session (cookie `__Host-trv_session`).
WebAuthn request options for `navigator.credentials.get()` (any passkey of this site).
`passkey`: 204 and a rotated session. `magic_link`: 202, a link is e-mailed.

202.description: Confirmation link sent to the account's address

post.description: WebAuthn request options limited to the signed-in user's passkeys.
Use the e-mailed confirmation link (in the browser of the session it confirms).

get.description: The place at the browser's position; 404 when there is none (at sea, abroad).

patch.description: Change the username, display name, bio or language. `If-Match: <version>` required.

post.description:
First step of /bienvenue (Q11). Under the minimum age nothing is kept: the account is
erased, the session cookie cleared, and the answer is `400 too_young`.

400.description: too_young: the account has been erased

get.description: Signed in or not: an anonymous browser is recognised by `__Host-trv_anon`.

post.description:
Records a choice (granting or withdrawing) and answers the new state. An anonymous
browser without a valid `__Host-trv_anon` receives one (13 months).

GDPR export (ADR-0016): built by the worker, announced by e-mail. A request still in
progress is answered again instead of starting a second one.

404.description: Unknown, someone else's, not ready or expired

post.description: Send a confirmation link to the new address. Same answer whatever the address.

Account erasure (Q10): every session is revoked (this one too) and the public profile
hidden at once; the account is erased after the grace period unless the person signs in
again and cancels.

put.description: Replace all preferences; a field not sent goes back to its default.

delete.description: Sign out everywhere else; the current session stays open.

get.description: Pending requests this person could decide (they hold the permission), theirs included.

post.description:
Grant or revoke a staff role on a staff account (`staff_roles.manage`, 🔒 dual approval
for the super-administrator: 202 and a pending request).
Also removes the follows in both directions; unblocking does not bring them back.

404.description: Unknown or hidden member, or a block in either direction
Unknown or hidden member, or a block in either direction

get.description:
404 for an unknown name, an account not active or restricted, a profile not yet
completed, or an account whose erasure was requested. Visible to the people it blocks.
